Ranked by tasks solved, then productive pass rate. A task is solved when at least 2 of 3 productive repeats pass. CIs: cluster bootstrap over whole tasks, 4000 resamples, seed 20261110, one stream in registry order (data/models.json). Ladder height: highest rung n with families R1..Rn all eligible. Token counts are as reported by each route; output tokens include reasoning tokens where the route reports them. Wall time per trial includes transport and scoring; TTFT and tok/s come from different instruments per route (see data/models.json) and are not directly comparable across routes. tok/s uses only turns that report zero reasoning tokens, because the streaming instrument counts reasoning tokens but times only visible content. Power draw was not metered for any route, so no energy column is reported.
